- `fastapi.security.http`: `HTTPBase`, `HTTPBasic`, `HTTPBearer`, `HTTPDigest`
- `fastapi.security.oauth2`: `OAuth2`, `OAuth2PasswordBearer`, `OAuth2AuthorizationCodeBearer`
